full_details: The almanac had no feast for the day. At St Helen's, Master Thwaite would not write one in, and he would not repeat yesterday's sermon. Sir John Spencer sat his pew and did not speak. There was no sword-bearer. Mistress Ansell sent you in to dinner at threepence. In the afternoon you looked at the one page of the other play and added nothing. At the window you named Ovid, Marlowe, Kyd, and Greene, stopped before a phrase of your mother's, and turned to the Friar's letter. You did not open the tomb.
one_sentence: You stood through morning prayer, and at the window named the dead who live in books.
title: Stood through morning prayer
